note: The one place the executable Owner-intent vocabulary is written down. Both the deterministic validator and the interpreter prompt read THIS file; neither owns the list. A value absent here is not executable, whatever a model returns.

non_executable.meaning: the interpreter could not classify the request; a real semantic outcome, never an execution

removed.reason: prompt-declared with no executable consumer anywhere (Owner decision 2026-09-02). Not aliased to LIST_AVAILABLE_CAPABILITIES: creating runtime behaviour to preserve an orphaned prompt word would invent a capability nobody built.

observed_outside_contract.note: produced by the deterministic ladder on the /owner/message path, never by a model and never passed to validateOwnerIntent. Recorded here so it is visible, deliberately NOT added to `executable` — the Owner's decision named seven values and this is not one of them.
